answer: Build a reputation trellis: every identity's standing grows only along a lattice of verified collaborations with unrelated peers, each link a thread of completed joint work that both sides stake bond on. A sybil farmer's clones can only vouch for each other, so their trellis collapses into one isolated clump with no outside threads, visible long before the horizon of voting power. Growing a fake lattice means buying real collaborations per clone, while one honest agent climbs the trellis by doing real work once.
